notes: SR98 La Redoute Interieurs FR (laredoute.fr). ACCESS: direct HTTP (curl) and Playwright both got the same Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403 on / and on all /pplp/ listing paths, matching the prior Home-Decor pass and the UK sibling's block pattern. WebFetch rendered the homepage and non-/pplp/ landing pages fine but also got 403 on every /pplp/ URL tested (a regression vs. the prior pass, which used WebFetch successfully on /pplp/ pages). Claude-in-Chrome (real browser, last-resort tier) got past the block on /pplp/ pages, so it was used for all PLP verification. robots.txt has no Claude-named disallow (checked before using Claude-in-Chrome). NAVIGATION: main nav 'Maison' menu includes a top-level 'Best-sellers' link (/pplp/cat-385755.aspx) alongside category links. This is the general multi-brand marketplace bestsellers page (grouped by category: Femme, Linge de maison, Lit literie, Canape fauteuil, Tapis, Enfant bebe, Table chaise, Meuble, Homme, Luminaire, Decoration, Art de la table, Jardin, Electromenager - many non-LRI brands e.g. LEVI'S, ADIDAS, APPLE, VILLEROY & BOCH). Applied the site's own brndid=la-redoute-interieurs filter (same convention used in the prior Home-Decor pass to scope this company) - the filter worked correctly here (title changed to 'Best-sellers LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS', all products confirmed single-brand LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS via DOM brand-name scan), converting the page from a category-grouped carousel layout into a flat paginated PLP with 'Page 1 sur 9' and an exact count of 815 shown next to the page heading (same bare-number count UI pattern used site-wide, verified via DOM inspection that the '815' element's container text reads 'Best-sellers LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS Best-sellers 815'). No genuine LRI-specific sub-structure (e.g. 'Furniture Bestsellers') was found once brand-filtered - it collapses to one flat listing, so a single row is emitted. Checked robots.txt, main/mega nav, footer, and site search (site search proved unreliable/non-discriminating, matching known site-search caveats, so treated as supporting evidence only, not primary).
